questions.question: Choose the correct expression from the following?
options: Will you tell me how much is it?
I did not know where are they going?
Why you are angry with me?
Where do you want to go now?
questions.explanation: Embedded question অনুযায়ী option A তে how much it is হবে। Option B তে assertive sentence অর্থাৎ, where they are going হবে। Option C তে why are you angry with me? হবে।

questions.question: Select the correct tense in the following sentence "I will have studied every tense by the time I finish the course".
questions.explanation: Future perfect tense এর গঠন: Subject + shall have /will have + V3 + extension।

questions.question: "I wish we did not have to use ________ car for the trip to your reunion" Fill up the gap in the above sentence with the correct pronoun.
questions.explanation: প্রদত্ত বাক্যের শূন্যস্থানে pronoun এর possessive form বসবে। আমাদের গাড়ি = our car.

questions.question: He took advantage ____ my absence to steal my book".
questions.explanation: Take advantage of sth কাউকে প্রতারণা করা/ কোনো কিছুর সুযোগ নেওয়া।

questions.question: Choose the sentence that contains the correct preposition?
options: I confront to you with this point
This climate is congenial to my health
We condoled to him on his loss

questions.question: Choose the correct form of sentence from the following-
options: Our tootball team played bad this afternoon
The air in the sewer smelled badly
The medicine does not taste too bad
questions.explanation: Option A তে Play verb এর পর adverb (badly) হবে। Option B ও C তে feel, smell হলো linking verb তাই এর পর adjective হবে। সুতরাং বাক্যের গঠন অনুযায়ী সঠিক উত্তর: D।

questions.question: Choose the correct synonym for the word 'cheerful'.

questions.question: Select the sentence with a suffix that is an adverb.
options: The equation that was given to him was solvable
There was a structural defect in the monument
The decoration of the gate was spectacular
questions.explanation: Fluent হলো adjective, এর সাথে ly suffix যুক্ত হয়ে adverb হিসেবে ব্যবহৃত হয়েছে এবং speak verb কে নির্দেশ করছে।

questions.question: Which of the following is a correct example of demonstrative pronoun?
options: These shirts have been ironed properly
Did you see that crazy driver
questions.explanation: shirts, this dress, that crazy driver, এই তিন স্থানেই these, this, that শব্দগুলো adjective হিসেবে ব্যবহৃত হয়েছে। তাই এগুলো pronoun নয়। Pronoun সাধারণত বাক্যের subject কিংবা object হিসেবে বসে

questions.question: Which of the following sentence has the incorrect subject-verb agreement
options: Some people in my office are very annoying
One hundred dollars is a lot of money for a bottle of wine.
Two hours is a long time to wait to see a doctor
Ford in addition to Toyota are lowering its car prices to encourge better sales
questions.explanation: In addition to, as well as, accompanied by প্রভৃতি থাকলে প্রথম subject অনুযায়ী verb হয়। তাই এই বাক্যে Ford এর verb হিসেবে is lowering ব্যবহৃত হবে।

questions.question: Which one of the following sentences contain an adjective clause?
options: The amount I had in the bank was exactly sixty pounds
He hoped that he would win prize
I was quite well so long as I stayed there
You may criticize what I do
questions.explanation: Option A-তে I had in the bank হলো adjective clause যা the amount (noun) কে modify করছে।

questions.question: Choose the sentence which has the correct adverb placement.
options: We were last week in London
questions.explanation: Adverb Placement is usually after a verb. এ অনুযায়ী বাক্যে fluently adverb ঠিক স্থানে বসেছে

questions.question: Choose the correct word for the blank "They are not accustomed.......... such a lifestyle.
questions.explanation: Be accustomed to sth phrase এর অর্থ কোনোকিছুতে অভ্যস্ত হওয়া।

questions.question: Which of the following is an example of present perfect continuous tense?
questions.explanation: Present perfect continuous tense এর গঠন: Subject + has been/ have been + V + ing + extension

questions.question: Choose the sentence without a personal pronoun.
options: We have to leave, so give our sears to them
She told us that we were late for the party
There was a river in the distance
I said that she told him to leave us alone
questions.explanation: ব্যক্তির নামের পরিবর্তে যে সকল pronoun ব্যবহৃত হয় তাদেরকে personal pronoun বলে। যেমন- 1st person: I, me, we, us; 2nd person: You, your; 3rd person: he, she, it, him, her, they, them etc.
